title: Polygon and OKX Explorer Announce First Official Support for AggLayer Integration
description: Exciting news in the blockchain world! OKLink has announced a collaboration with Polygon, making OKX Explorer the first official block explorer for AggLayer. This partnership aims to empower developers and the entire Web3 community by providing comprehensive tools and data for AggChain needs. With the integration of AggLayer and Polygon CDK, OKX Explorer offers enhanced functionality and detailed blockchain data. This collaboration marks a significant advancement in blockchain technology, supporting robust and scalable solutions. Explore the future of decentralized applications with OKX Explorer, now officially supporting AggLayer and Polygon CDK-built chains.
